visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair and bangs, wearing a black t-shirt and a white smartwatch, is seated in a brightly lit indoor space with beige walls. She speaks directly to the camera, using animated hand gestures to emphasize her words. A framed artwork with the word 'EVENTUALLY' hangs in the background. (2) A small portrait of a man, Peter Attia, appears as a digital overlay on the left side of the frame while the woman continues her explanation. The setting remains constant with soft, even lighting. (3) The woman gestures with her right hand, pointing and making an 'okay' sign as she discusses technical terms. She rests her left hand on a dark table surface where a tablet or book with yellow stickers is visible. (4) The visual transitions to a screen capture of a mobile app interface showing a blue line graph with data points tracking 'VO2 max' values from 33 to 36. The woman's hands remain visible at the bottom of the frame. (5) The woman returns to the primary medium shot, continuing her talk with a friendly expression. She concludes by pointing towards the viewer, maintaining eye contact with the lens throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 據說VO2 max是預測全因死亡率. [Logo]: EVENTUALLY. (2) [Subtitle]: 非常重要而且獨立的指標. (3) [Subtitle]: 甚至Peter Attia說. (4) [Subtitle]: 這是預測壽命最重要的指標. (5) [Subtitle]: VO2 max 是什麼呢. (6) [Subtitle]: 身體在一分鐘內能使用的最高氧氣的量. (7) [Subtitle]: 一般人大概是30-60 ml/kg/min. (8) [Subtitle]: 頂尖運動員可以到 90 ml/kg/min. (9) [Subtitle]: 如果你想要健康的、老化的、維持好的VO2 max. (10) [Subtitle]: 這個是很值得參考的. (11) [Subtitle]: 雖然我一週運動三次. (12) [Subtitle]: 我的VO2 max大概只有33而已. (13) [Subtitle]: 是非常、非常、非常的普通. (14) [Subtitle]: 大概平均以下. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以我就去查了一下要怎麼樣提高我的VO2 max. (16) [Subtitle]: 第一個是間歇性高強度運動. (17) [Subtitle]: 專家有推薦一個叫Norwegian 4x4的菜單. (18) [Subtitle]: 我想要優雅的老去，不是直接死去，所以這個直接pass. (19) [Subtitle]: 第二個就是持續運動超過20分鐘，每週3到5次. (20) [Subtitle]: 那我已經有這個習慣了. (21) [Subtitle]: 第三個就是快跑上坡，維持Zone2的心率. (22) [Subtitle]: 就是你最大心率的60%到70%. (23) [Subtitle]: 是一個可以講話但不能唱歌的運動程度. (24) [Subtitle]: 做45到60分鐘. (25) [Subtitle]: 據說六週可以顯著提升VO2 max達到 +10%. (26) [Variety]: +10%. (27) [Subtitle]: 一個月後我的確VO2 max從33成長到36. (28) [Subtitle]: 但我的脂肪也隨之增加. (29) [Subtitle]: 做Zone 2很好，但真的對女性的減脂效果不是那麼高. (30) [Subtitle]: 如果你想要知道的話，請去看我YouTube最新講Zone 2的影片.
